scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @flint/agent && npm run dev --workspace @flint/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @flint/agent && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --project api/src/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.agent:demo: npm run contracts:build && npm run build --workspace @flint/agent && node scripts/agent-demo.mjs
scripts.agent:test:integration: npm run contracts:build && npm run test:integration --workspace @flint/agent
scripts.web:local: npm run contracts:build && npm run build --workspace @flint/agent && node scripts/start-workspace.mjs
scripts.web:test:e2e: npm run contracts:build && npm run build --workspace @flint/agent && npm run build --workspace @flint/web && playwright test
scripts.demo:scenarios: npm run contracts:build && npm run build --workspace @flint/agent && node scripts/run-security-demos.mjs
scripts.demo:record: npm run contracts:build && npm run build --workspace @flint/agent && npm run build --workspace @flint/web && node scripts/record-demo.mjs
scripts.demo:serve: npm run contracts:build && npm run build --workspace @flint/agent && npm run build --workspace @flint/web && node scripts/record-demo.mjs --serve
